key_insight: Combining Neural Prophet's time-series decomposition with a dedicated deep neural network (NP-DNN) yields improved accuracy and probabilistic range estimates for short- to medium-term stock price forecasting.
problem_solved: Existing statistical time-series methods often struggle to produce accurate point forecasts and reliable probability ranges (uncertainty bands) for future stock prices; NP-DNN addresses both accuracy and uncertainty quantification simultaneously.
method: Hybrid architecture: Neural Prophet for trend/seasonality/decomposition + a Deep Neural Network module to learn non-linear residuals and complex market patterns.
Probabilistic forecasting: model produces predictive intervals (probability ranges) rather than only point estimates to capture forecast uncertainty.
End-to-end training on historical price series and engineered features (lags, returns, technical indicators) with evaluation against baselines using accuracy and interval metrics.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical hybrid blueprint to get more reliable stock forecasts with uncertainty estimates, enabling better risk-aware trading and model selection in finance applications.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram showing Neural Prophet decomposition feeding residuals into a DNN block
Time-series plot: actual vs predicted with shaded predictive intervals (uncertainty bands)
Bar chart comparing accuracy and interval coverage (RMSE, MAPE, PICP) across NP-DNN and baseline models
Feature importance / correlation heatmap illustrating which engineered indicators drive the DNN residual corrections
paper_title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
paper_authors: Navin Chhibber, Suneel Khemka, Navneet Kumar Tyagi, Rohit Tewari, Bireswar Banerjee
